question: Does a mediator-only payout increase close the measured Vow-5 policy gap while preserving four separated packages and RandomBuild movement?

competingOptions.statement: The existing four mediators support two retained viable routes per aspect and vow after their conditional payouts increase.
One or more routes remain below C2 or the conditional increase causes broad movement, collapse or a reliability failure.

estimands.functionalSeparation: Named diagonal interaction lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD; every off-diagonal upper bound below 0.25.
estimands.panelActivation: Named consumer response in AB minus B, standardised by pooled consumer response; lower 95% bound at least 0.25 SD.
estimands.policySensitivity: At least eight independent policies per package and split apply and consume the mediator with positive consumer activation.
estimands.buildSensitivity: A planned build policy receives two existing aspect-bonus units only when a reward completes a package already represented in its deck. RandomBuild is unchanged.
estimands.reliability: Applicable-aspect package panels add no non-win and do not lengthen combat; whole-run errors and stalls fail closed.
estimands.reachability: Legacy rewards acquire, play and activate both components for at least two distinct policies per applicable aspect/vow and split.
estimands.globalMovement: Candidate-minus-live RandomBuild arm-2 win-rate point movement is at most 0.10 in magnitude per grid; an interval crossing the bound extends under the frozen ladder.

successRule.functionalSeparation: All four diagonals and twelve off-diagonals pass discovery and held-out evidence.
successRule.packageActivation: All four packages meet activation, witness, aspect-separation, reliability and duration gates in both splits.
successRule.aspectIdentity: Scoreline and Afterimage remain Dusk-only; Smolder and Bloodfire remain Ash-only.
successRule.reachability: All four packages meet the legacy-economy rule in both splits.
successRule.globalMovement: Every held-out RandomBuild movement is within 0.10.
successRule.c2: In every grid, RandomBuild arm 2 is below 0.50 and each aspect has two route endpoints represented by at least two policies with a gap of at least 0.35.
successRule.retention: Both route endpoint rates per grid remain within 0.10 of the top route and have distinct policy witness sets.
successRule.vow5: Every held-out top route-policy win rate is at most 0.90.

cheapestDiscriminatingExperiment: Re-run 32-pair separation and panels, then paired 32-seed controls and a 64-policy by 8-seed landscape. Extend only a threshold-overlapping or underpowered rectangle.
inconclusiveRule: Intervals overlapping a threshold at the first look extend to the frozen maximum on the same cohort. At the maximum they stop inconclusive. Candidate values, policy logic and estimands do not change.
stopRule: Reject immediately after any decisive package, separation, reliability, global-movement, identity, C2, retention or Vow-5 failure. Detector mutations remain forbidden until all content gates pass.
